Nadváha a obezita– Přístupy k hodnocení, výskyt, příčiny, následky, prevence. (dotace 2/2)
Výživa lidí v ohrožení. Humanitární organizace poskytující potravinovou pomoc. (dotace 2/2)

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Students will acquire knowledge, skills and competences in the field of Food Safety, both from the point of view of Food Security and Food Safety. Based on this knowledge, their ability of team work and critical thinking, students will be able to evaluate various factors and risks affecting the food safety.
